answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh ridge challenge every epoch. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra nectar buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. What cannot be bought is a jury that already trusts you. Each shale has to be earned inside a panel system that prices collusion at the loss of every seat granted. Seal 133d5.
